relevance_note: The paper describes seven individually tabulated LAMP2 carriers: 'Each of the seven patients was identified with one mutation in the LAMP2 gene (Table I and Fig. 2)'.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script transcribed Table I (patients as columns; column headers are 'Family F1 III-9' ... 'Family F7 III-8', used verbatim as labels) and built the JSON; every transcribed cell was checked against the table. Spans for Table I quote the row from its label through the patient's cell. Scope: the 7 LAMP2 patients plus the father of the Family F2 proband (described as having milder disease, not stated to be tested; no variant row). Other relatives appear only in Figure 1 (not in text) and are not extracted; PRKAG2, Fabry and sarcomere patients are out of scope. Table I symbols: '-' cells (sudden death, syncope, SAM) are not defined as absent in the legend, so they are not reported; '^b' = lack of assessment and '^a' = lack of information are not reported; '+' was read as present. 'History of sudden death' (^c within pedigree, + for F2) is a family history, not recorded as the patient's feature. 'Arrhythmia: Normal' (F1, F3, F6) recorded as arrhythmia excluded; per the normal-findings rule it does not exclude specific checklist arrhythmias. 'Ocular manifestation: No' (F3) does not exclude retinopathy or myopia. 'Cognitive impairment: No' (F1, F3, F4) is narrower than the composite checklist item, so that item is left not reported. CK-MB (cardiac isoenzyme) was not taken as elevated creatine kinase. NYHA class III and LVEF 20.6% for F7 were not mapped to heart failure or reduced EF (no explicit statement). Group statements about unnamed subsets (four with fQRS, one with mild skeletal myopathy, two asymptomatic frameshift carriers before age 1, one male missense patient with chest tightness at 11 years, four variants found in a parent / one de novo / two untested, three point and four frameshift mutations, five novel) were not assigned to individuals, so variant type, inheritance and parental testing are not reported. 'All patients had an HCM phenotype on presentation' was applied to all seven as a named-group statement (LVH observed). Pathogenicity 'pathogenic' comes from the named-group statement 'A pathogenic mutation in LAMP2 was identified in 7 patients'. Only F2, F3 and F5 are explicitly called probands; is_proband is null for the others. F3 had normal LVOT gradient and diastolic function at first visit but LVOTO and damaged diastolic function later (temporal change, both rows emitted; checklist LVOTO observed). Contradictions/inconsistencies in the paper: text gives mean MLVWT 17 mm (range 14-24 mm) but Table I lists 8-25 mm (F7 MLVWT 8 mm despite 'all patients had an HCM phenotype'); Table II reports pacemaker implantation 0 (0) in Danon patients but Table I lists CRT-P for Family F4 III-3; F3 S_V1+R_V5 is 10.4 mV in Table I but RV5 + SV1=12.2 mV in the case report; text says two patients had preexcitation (F4, F5 in Table I) while F3 later developed delta waves resembling WPW; text says 2 patients were asymptomatic (Table I 'None' for F4 and F6) while the Discussion says two asymptomatic frameshift carriers were found before their first birthday (F4 is a 20-year-old with c.928G>A).
